 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word '**elapsed'** means the passage of time or the duration that has passed. (बीत गया)

 
 
• **Example: **Two hours had **elapsed** since they started their journey.
 
 
 
• **'Elapsed'** is often used to indicate the amount of time that has passed between two events. (बीत गया)
 
 
• **Example: **Only a few minutes had **elapsed **before the meeting was adjourned.
 
 

Therefore, the correct statement is 'and Lavinia’s steps came up the stairs and passed the door to the guest room beyond. And then after a couple of centuries ***elapsed***....'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Crossed** (पार किया): To move from one side to another.

 
 
• **Example:** She ***crossed ***the street to get to the other side.
 
 
 
• **Eroded** (कटाव): Gradually wear away (soil, rock, or land).
 
 
• **Example: **The coastline has ***eroded*** significantly over the years.
 
 
 
• **Persisted** (दृढ़): Continue firmly or obstinately in an opinion or a course of action.
 
 
• **Example:** Despite the difficulties, she*** persisted ***in her efforts to succeed.
